description: Archi stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonext.comune.modena.it. In base alla legge 1228 del 1954 ed al D P R 223 del 1989 ogni Comune provvede all indicazione dell onomastica stradale e della numerazione civica e alla cura della compilazione e aggiornamento dello stradario. Coverage: Modena. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://w3id.org/italia/controlled-vocabulary/licences/A21_CCBY40). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
